set.body: Studio (eyes4s-7e) asked on 2026-09-26, from the S2.1 review. For each admitted input file Studio records the byte digest plus eyes4s's semantic identity, and the semantic identity is currently None. Wanted: a pure, JVM+JS type in plan (or core), e.g. SourceRef, naming what a whole source file means independently of its bytes: format and parser definition id/version, the semantic content digest that the importer's ledger already computes, and the admission options that shaped it. It must be produced by the io importers (ASC, CSV, trials) and recorded in the admission ledger/manifest. Must coordinate with the ledger re-verification ticket bd-01M2SC6N15J2N7PHD4DXBE43VD, which re-runs the importer to check this identity. Needs a design sketch sent to eyes4s-7e before implementation.
set.title: Cross-built semantic identity (SourceRef) for a whole input file
